newsitem.title: GERMANY: Vereinsbank has 225,000 phone, PC clients.
newsitem.headline: Vereinsbank has 225,000 phone, PC clients.

text.p: Germany's Bayerische Vereinsbank AG said on Thursday that 225,000 of its clients were now using telephone and PC-based banking services.
Of that number, 200,000 were customers of the main bank and 25,000 clients of Advance Bank, Vereinsbank's recently-launched direct banking subsidiary.
Management board chairman Albrecht Schmidt told a news conference the bank planned to expand its direct banking services and would introduce a PC-based securities order service from this summer.
As of the autumn, loans and standard mortgage transactions would also be processed on the telephone, he said.
More than two million transactions, a volume of 2.4 billion marks, had been processed via these media in 1996, Schmidt said, representing 30 percent of the target client group.
Some 14 percent of private client share orders were already handled by telephone.
